title: Daily Planning & Focus Polish (v4.3.0)
summary: Daily planning now feels easier to run, focus controls are clearer, and support flows give you faster help with less typing.
notes:
## What's New
- Daily planning and Focus Intention flows are now cleaner and easier to manage
- Session setup, Shield, and focus controls feel more consistent across the app
- Header and progression visuals are clearer, with smoother XP feedback and polish
- Support form now better auto-fills your info (including linked email and saved name)
- Support requests now send clearer contact context so replies are easier
- Large internal cleanup improved stability and maintainability across core features

title: Control, Progress & Reliability (v4.2.0)
summary: Focus sessions feel more predictable: Shield readiness is clearer, reminders are stronger, and progress tracking gives better feedback.
notes:
## What's New
- Shield now clearly tells you when apps or permissions are missing before a focus session
- Planned Sessions now send stronger reminders and keep missed sessions visible
- New XP, levels, and Focus Score begin shaping progress around real focus quality
- Goblin reactions now better reflect streak risk, comebacks, XP moments, and missed planned sessions
- Account sync now protects more progress, settings, and planned-session state across reinstalls
- Purchase and account setup flows are more stable
- Session notifications are more reliable during active focus sessions

title: Setup & Onboarding Smoother (v4.1.2)
summary: Getting started is easier, Shield setup feels clearer, and smaller-screen layouts are more comfortable during onboarding.
notes:
## What's New
- Onboarding is smoother and easier to follow
- Choosing apps for your Shield is now faster and more intuitive
- Better layout and spacing on smaller screens
- Improved consistency across different devices
- Cleaner visuals with more refined spacing and typography
- Shield setup is now faster and more reliable
- General polish and stability improvements
- Better performance across the app

title: Launch Setup & Purchase Flow Updates (v4.1.1)
summary: App selection and paywall clarity improved, so setup feels more guided and launch decisions are easier.
notes:
## What's New
- Selected apps now stay pinned while you build or edit your block list
- Shield editing actions now match the rest of the app controls
- Yearly Pro pricing is clearer with the monthly equivalent up front
- Terms and Privacy dialogs are shorter, scrollable, and easier to close
- Small launch polish across paywall, Shield, and onboarding flows

title: Focus Expansion: Sharper Control (v4.0.0)
summary: CogniFocus expanded beyond a basic timer with Manual Block, smarter guidance, and stronger in-session control.
notes:
## What's New
- Manual Block adds stronger control outside sessions
- Session objectives are visible and used in reactions
- You can adjust a session mid-focus without restarting
- Smarter focus guidance adds drift and burnout nudges
- Planned Sessions were added to Pro
- Personality responses were improved

## Improvements
- UI consistency, notification reliability, performance, and stability
